version.description: merging updates from Production Aggregations patch

data.query:
query Query($where: ProductionHistoryWhereInput, $orderBy: [ProductionHistoryOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  productionHistory(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        actualLaborHours
        actualMachineHours
        actualSetupHours
        earnedLaborHours
        earnedMachineHours
        earnedSetupHours
        quantity
        includeProductionCounts
        externalId
        creditedAt
        occurAt
        assetData
        customData
        productionHistoryStatusId
        transactionTypeId
        workcenterId
        aggregationId
        distributionId
        distributionGroupId
        inventoryId
        kanbanCardId
        masterInventoryId
        productId
        productStrategyProcessId
        productionRunId
        scrapReasonId
        shiftId
        workOrderId
        workOrder {
          workOrderTypeId
          orderReference
          integrationData
        }
        workOrderProcessId
        workOrderProcess {
          final
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
